methodology.price: SNKRDUNK completed-sales chart print for PSA10 (not Grade A ask)
methodology.missingDays: Per-card last observation carried forward; never fill ¥0
methodology.index: Chained daily returns from LOCF prices; first day with ≥40 names = 1,000
methodology.equal: Arithmetic mean of available card returns (site headline; not Pokeca Jevons)
methodology.liquidity: Weight ∝ SNK last-20 PSA10 sold yen in the prior 30d as of the previous JST day; if none, sum of PSA10 chart-print yen. 3% cap.
methodology.priceWeight: Lagged yen price / sum of lagged yen prices, then 3% cap
methodology.priceNoCap: Same lagged yen share, no 3% cap — overlay only
methodology.outliers: Print-to-print gap > 14d is a re-entry (0 return, rebase). Remaining card-day returns winsorized at ±25%
methodology.volume: Count of basket cards with a PSA10 chart print that JST calendar day
methodology.reconstitution: Quarterly membership (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct 1 JST); daily weight rebalance
methodology.sectors: VINTAGE pre-SM (~1996–2016: XY/BW/DP/…); MODERN SM+S (Tag Team lives here too); CURRENT SV+MEGA. N floats from yen/print-day screens (no floor, no cap). Composite = union of the three sectors. PROMO and MID/Tag Team are sibling series.
